question: What per-minute limit do the TheNews API and Marketaux free tokens carry (the X-RateLimit-Limit header), and does a free token return the documented 3 articles a request?
why: Both documentation pages name an HTTP 429 for too many requests in the past 60 seconds and put its size in a response header that only a token shows; the register form is a sign-up, so the value is unverified: behind a sign-up.
